description: This is a Go source file implementing a cluster discovery mechanism for etcd v2 client, including functions for joining a cluster, retrieving cluster info, and managing discovery nodes.

classes.name: discovery
classes.description: Represents a discovery client managing cluster registration and retrieval.

classes.name: sortableNodes
classes.description: A sortable wrapper for client nodes based on creation index.

methods.name: newProxyFunc
methods.description: Builds a proxy function from a URL string, with sanitization.

methods.name: newDiscovery
methods.description: Creates a new discovery client instance with configuration.

methods.name: joinCluster
methods.description: Joins a cluster by registering self and waiting for peers.

methods.name: createSelf
methods.description: Creates a node entry in the discovery service.

methods.name: checkCluster
methods.description: Checks cluster status, size, and node list.

methods.name: logAndBackoffForRetry
methods.description: Logs retry attempts and performs exponential backoff.

methods.name: checkClusterRetry
methods.description: Retries cluster check with backoff, up to max retries.

methods.name: waitNodesRetry
methods.description: Retries waiting for nodes with backoff, up to max retries.

methods.name: waitNodes
methods.description: Waits for all nodes to appear via watch, with retries.

methods.name: selfKey
methods.description: Generates the key for the current node.
